dwarven resilience.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison. Resistance against poison damage.

trance.description: Elves don't need to sleep. They can rest while doing light activity for 4 hours.

fey ancestry.description: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed.

lucky.description: When you roll a 1, reroll the die and take the new result.

gnome cunning.description: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

keen smell.description: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

brave.description: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

stonecunning.description: History check related to stonework has advantage.

sunlight sensitivity.description: Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks in direct sunlight.

relentless endurance.description: When reduced to 0 HP, can drop to 1 HP instead once per long rest.

mask of the wild.description: You can attempt to hide when only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, mist, or snow.

artificer's lore.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence check related to magical, alchemical, or technological items, double your proficiency bonus.

stout resilience.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison.

breath weapon (acid).description: As an action, exhale acid in a 5-foot by 30-foot line or 15-foot cone. Dex save to take 2d6 damage.

breath weapon (lightning).description: As an action, exhale lightning in a 5-foot by 30-foot line or 15-foot cone. Dex save to take 2d6 damage.

breath weapon (poison).description: As an action, exhale poison in a 5-foot by 30-foot line or 15-foot cone. Con save to take 2d6 damage.

breath weapon (fire).description: As an action, exhale fire in a 5-foot by 30-foot line or 15-foot cone. Dex save to take 2d6 damage.

breath weapon (cold).description: As an action, exhale cold in a 5-foot by 30-foot line or 15-foot cone. Dex save to take 2d6 damage.
